messages:
Rita Gomez: Hi everyone, joining today — kit arrived but running into a few issues. Dock powers laptop but monitor stays on 'No Signal' (using dock HDMI). USB-A mouse also drops for a few seconds every minute. Tried rebooting. VPN setup never prompted for the corp cert and now VPN shows 'certificate not found'. Should I open a ticket or try something first?

Lee (IT): Welcome @Rita! Quick checks: 1) confirm monitor input is HDMI; 2) try DisplayPort if dock has it; 3) try the other USB-A port or a different mouse to rule out cable; 4) did you run the VPN installer as admin? If you can, run Device Manager and System Report and paste any warning. I'll standby.

Rita Gomez: Monitor input was HDMI. Switched to DP -> still black. Mouse disconnects then reconnects in System Report showing the device briefly vanish. Laptop is ThinkPad T14s (Win11). I didn't run VPN installer as admin.

Lee (IT): Ok please run the VPN installer as admin (right-click -> Run as administrator). Also power-cycle the dock: unplug power and wait 10s, then plug back. If DP still fails, try a direct USB-C->DP cable to the monitor to determine if the dock is the issue. I'll open a ticket to track this so we don't lose context.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2039 created by Lee (IT) for Rita Gomez — "New hire: dock passthrough no signal, intermittent USB-A mouse disconnects, VPN cert not provisioning". Priority: P2. ETA initial triage 2 hours.

Nina Torres: Welcome Rita :wave: I had the same dock and the mouse kept disconnecting — turned out the dock needed a firmware update. IT pushed a FW update and the USB stability improved. If you're in the SF office I can swing by with a spare mouse.

Rita Gomez: Ran installer as admin and VPN prompted to install a certificate; I accepted and VPN authenticated. After power-cycling dock the monitor flickered and then woke up — looks like it's stable now. Mouse still blips once. Thanks for the fast replies, I'll keep IT-2039 open until mouse is fixed.

Lee (IT): Great progress. I'll set IT-2039 to track a replacement dock if the mouse issue persists after a firmware push. We can push the dock firmware remotely later today. :thumbsup:
